sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: To ask the same question back, say *És te?*, “And you?” After a statement it hands the turn to the other person: *Olvasok. És te?* To ask about someone else, put the name after *és*: *És Anna?*

sections.title: Short reactions
sections.content: Short reactions keep a conversation going. *Tényleg?* means “Really?”, *persze* means “of course” and *talán* means “perhaps”. *Talán* stands before the part it is unsure about: *Talán Anna főz.*

items.english: I study. And you? – I cook.

sections.content: Answer *És te?* about yourself, so the verb takes its “I” ending: *Olvasok. És te? – Én főzök.*
